tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Existence of Partitions of Unity] 1. chA:A.11[LeeSM, Thm. 2.23] If $M$ is a smooth manifold with or without boundary and $\mathcal{U} = \{ U_\alpha \} _{\alpha \in A}$ is an indexed open cover of $M$, then there exists a smooth partition of unity subordinate to $\mathcal{U}$.
